# Data license

The files in this directory are **not** covered by the repository's MIT License.

- `jolpica/`: race results, qualifying, sprint, schedule and standings data from the
  [Jolpica-F1 API](https://github.com/jolpica/jolpica-f1) (Ergast-compatible), licensed under
  [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/)
  ([terms](https://github.com/jolpica/jolpica-f1/blob/main/TERMS.md)).
- `openf1/`: sprint qualifying classifications from the [OpenF1 API](https://openf1.org), licensed
  under [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/). See `openf1/LICENSE.md`.

Files are stored as returned by the APIs, apart from the sprint qualifying files, which are
reduced to classification order and driver codes. `MANIFEST.json` records each file's source and hash.

Reuse: credit the source, non-commercial use only, share adaptations under the same license.
Neither source is affiliated with Formula 1.
